extraReplayScenario.reason: Historical replay test calls a SigningWorker fault route gated by cfg(debug_assertions), absent from release build. Other lost-reply and historical replay flows are covered by passed E2E. No production or test edits made.

localVerification.browserE2E: 4 passed: NEAR admission replay and reload signing, lost finalization credential, protocol rejection/reload, immediate owner session
localVerification.reusedArtifacts: Gateway/server from accepted 6AJ, SDK/site from accepted 6AC. No private or SDK code changes.

sourceReview: DO owner name, ownership generation and authenticated home use existing binding lookup.
RPC passes the same Request and Response across the binding. Existing handler performs typed parsing and one storage transaction.
Protocol refusal codes remain structured HTTP-shaped responses within RPC. Transport failures retain LifecycleTransitionInProgress.
No cache, retry bypass, persistence schema, root-admission, cryptographic or lifecycle change.
The adapter retains private startup and observation fetch calls. Router command callers use RPC exclusively.

independentSignatureVerification.verifier: Node.js crypto Ed25519 with independent NEP-413 Borsh encoding

limitations: Three samples per arm establish neither tail percentiles nor a latency guarantee.
Sequential arms include provider scheduling and network variation; small differences cannot establish causality.
Fresh wallets do not guarantee cold Workers. Worker cold starts were not controlled.
Invocation wall time can include background work and is not browser response time.
Nested spans overlap. Protocol spans include transport; zero Worker clock spans do not prove zero CPU.
Existing bound-root counters cover six D1 calls, not all database work in registration.
Console HTTP counts exclude the captured scheduled event without a request path.
RPC preserves the existing Rust request parsing, command transaction and response encoding. This measures transport dispatch without a storage or protocol change.
Requested APAC placement does not prove physical colocation.

decision.reason: Initial claim waits were lower in the three RPC samples, but consumption varied across all arms and full registration did not improve. Keep the existing HTTP transport and avoid the additional adapter and build step.
decision.scope: Native RPC dispatch carries the existing Request/Response and invokes the unchanged Rust storage transaction. This does not test a different storage design or protocol encoding.
decision.nextCandidate: Consolidate fresh publishable-key authentication and active environment resolution during registration setup. Preserve origin, revocation, environment and tenant-root checks; target removal of one sequential Console request. The timing saving is unmeasured.
